queries:
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city AS town,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town,
         AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town_avg
)
SELECT t.town,
       t.avg_price,
       t.avg_ratio,
       t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_above_average
FROM town_avg t, overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town_city,
         AVG(avg_price) AS town_avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS town_avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM item_town
)
SELECT t.town_city,
       t.town_avg_price,
       t.town_avg_ratio,
       t.town_avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_above_average
FROM town_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.town_avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
WITH item AS (
    SELECT c.town_city,
           c.state_county_province,
           c.country,
           ili.order_item_id,
           AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
           AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
    JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.town_city, c.state_county_province, c.country, ili.order_item_id
),
town AS (
    SELECT town_city,
           state_county_province,
           country,
           AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
           AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM item
    GROUP BY town_city, state_county_province, country
)
SELECT town_city,
       avg_price,
       avg_ratio,
       avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town) AS ratio_above_average
FROM town
WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town);
WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city AS town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
per_town AS (
  SELECT town_city,
         AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM per_item
  GROUP BY town_city
)
SELECT town_city,
       avg_price,
       avg_ratio,
       avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_town) AS ratio_diff
FROM per_town
WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_town);
